title: Nine Points
summary: Xiao Yan finishes his Black Iron Spiritual Leaf extract just in time, to the relief of Ao Tuo. The extracts go into a Purity Meter scored out of ten, with four needed to pass. Liu Ling refined his six times and scores seven, Princess Yue Er's five refinements score 6.5, and the crowd laughs when Yan Xiao says he refined his eight times, until the meter shows nine. Yan Xiao takes first place, Gu He invites him to the Misty Cloud Sect and offers to make his master an honorary elder, and Princess Yue Er invites him to meet her great-grandfather Jia Xing Tian, a Dou Huang of the imperial family. Xiao Yan brushes them off and asks Ao Tuo to keep his identity secret. On the way to the Nalan Residence, Hai Bodong senses someone following them and goes to deal with it alone, and Xiao Yan walks into a banquet where Ya Fei greets Yan Xiao as an old friend in front of Nalan Yanran.
events: Xiao Yan finishes the extraction at the last second.
The Purity Meter is unveiled; four points are needed to pass.
Liu Ling scores seven with six refinements; Yue Er scores 6.5 with five.
Yan Xiao claims eight refinements and scores nine, taking first place.
Ao Tuo agrees to keep Yan Xiao's identity secret.
Gu He and Princess Yue Er court Yan Xiao; she names Jia Xing Tian as her great-grandfather.
Hai Bodong leaves to confront someone tailing them.
At the Nalan Residence banquet Ya Fei greets Yan Xiao warmly before Nalan Yanran.
introduced: Top Ten of the Jia Ma Empire (Jia Xing Tian among them)
foreign participants skip the internal test
